title: Router hardening: name R09's canonical route and pin R08's mechanism (close #83, the unnamed-hops defect)
objective: Close the research-router determinism gap (#83): the routing table left R08 (EMPIRICAL_EXPERIMENT) routing to an unnamed 'experimental loop' and R09 (STANDARDS) to unnamed 'authoritative sources'. Name R09's route to existing subskills (framing -> deep -> fact-check -> synthesis) and pin R08 to the existing BADF experiment mechanism (composed-tree gate + mutation + experiments[]), deferring a dedicated experimental-research subskill to P1 -- not creating a 10th subskill. Add a doc-structural contract test so no unnamed hop can return. badf-research stays DESIGNED.
business_value: A route that ends in an unnamed conceptual hop cannot be followed deterministically; naming R08/R09 to real subskills and a named mechanism makes every research route reconstructable, which is a pre-ACTIVE requirement, and the guard test stops the regression.
in_scope: tests/test_badf_research_contract.py: RouterDeterminismTests (no unnamed hop; R08/R09 named; route vocabulary resolves to registered subskills)
out_of_scope: creating an experimental-research subskill (deferred to P1)
any gate control on records (the router is docs; the teeth are the contract test)
acceptance_criteria: research-types.md no longer contains 'experimental loop' or 'authoritative sources'
R09 routes to framing -> deep -> fact-check -> synthesis; R08 names the BADF experiment mechanism + the P1 deferral
the router contract test passes and would fail on a reintroduced unnamed hop
the taxonomy contract tests still pass (R-codes/D-codes unaffected)
compose green both shapes; PyYAML-absent suite green; #83 closed by this PR
